description: This PHP trait defines methods and properties for configuring and managing Drupal migration processes, including database connection setup, system data retrieval, migration filtering, and version detection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Sets up and returns a database connection for the source Drupal database using provided connection info.

methods.name: getSystemData
methods.description: Retrieves system table data from the source Drupal database, handling missing table scenarios.

methods.name: createDatabaseStateSettings
methods.description: Creates and stores database connection settings in the state service for migration use.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Fetches and filters migration instances based on Drupal version, migration type, and tags, including requirement checks.

methods.name: getFollowUpMigrationTags
methods.description: Retrieves follow-up migration tags from configuration, caching the result.

methods.name: getLegacyDrupalVersion
methods.description: Detects the major Drupal version from the source database's system table schema version.

methods.name: getConfigFactory
methods.description: Provides access to the Drupal configuration factory service.

methods.name: getMigrationPluginManager
methods.description: Provides access to the migration plugin manager service.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Provides access to the Drupal state service.
